Definition: an Ashbelite (collectively) or descendant of Ashbel
BiblicalUsage: The Ashbelites are the family of Ashbel the son of Benjamin, named once, in the census in the plains of Moab. The sons of Benjamin after their families are counted, and of Ashbel comes the family of the Ashbelites.
TheologicalSignificance: The family of Ashbel counted in the wilderness carries no doctrine of its own; its weight is the record, that Benjamin's sons were numbered family by family before they entered the land.
